# dsh-prompt-seed
**English** | 简体中文
One contextual DSH composer entry: **✦ Optimize when the draft has content; 🔮 Crystal ball when empt
y**. The tools improve the draft or predict the user's most likely next reply. Neither sends message
*. The tools improve the draft or predict the user's most likely next reply. Neither sends messages.
> Version 0.21.1. See acceptance evidence for model quality, real-UI verification and known limitati
rsion 0.21.1. See acceptance evidence for model quality, real-UI verification and known limitations.
## Rewrite with useful substance
Short drafts gain essential execution details, boundaries and proportionate verification. Long spoke

n drafts become organized and shorter. Precise requests stay concise.
Preserve intent, scope, facts,
authorization, language, numbers, technical names and negative requirements—including “discuss only
, do not implement.” Do not invent features, metrics or an unchosen stack.
After generation, **Another version** uses the round's original draft, not the previous rewrite. Man
ual edits start a new round on the next click. Use **⋯ → Restore original** directly while untouched

; after editing, preview it before explicitly replacing the draft.
Empty input, greetings and pure c
onfirmations make no call. Unchanged results say “Unchanged,” distinct from improvement and failure.
## Predict the reply, not a recommended action
Crystal ball is available when the composer is empty, the conversation has an assistant reply and th
e assistant is idle. It uses recent conversation and user style to suggest one short reply: acknowle
dgement, question, correction, extra information or continuation. With insufficient evidence it repo

rts “Unable to predict for now.” Blank conversations make no call.
After a prediction fills the draf
t, the main icon switches to Optimize. **⋯** offers **Another reply** and **Withdraw** while the can
didate is untouched; editing removes those actions.
Success has no persistent text; a spinner indicates progress. Failure and unchanged results use shor
t labels with details on hover. **⋯** appears only when recovery, background cancellation or a retai
ned result is available. Switching the icon does not cancel either feature’s job.
## Independent features, safe drafts
Each feature owns its prompt, context strategy, controller, task state, result and undo. Only connec
tion, task storage, timeout and safe-write primitives are shared.

- At most one model call per generation; no hidden retries, repair calls or semantic judge.
- Jobs a
re scoped by conversation **and kind**. Switching, unmounting or disconnecting never cancels them; e

xplicit cancellation only affects its own kind.
- Automatic application requires the same conversati
on, editable input and unchanged draft revision, semantic references and attachments. Editing and re

verting to the same text still prevents overwrite.
- When unchanged state cannot be proved, includin

g reload/remount, results remain available in a preview with explicit **Replace draft**.
- Reference
chips use the host's semantic draft API. Unsafe reconstruction or newly inserted incompatible chips

makes the result preview-only. Text writes do not change attachments.
- Each conversation retains i
ts latest rewrite original/candidate across edits and switches. Confirmed submission clears recovery
; submission failure retains it. Draft persistence remains host-owned; recovery records live in the

browser tab.
- Existing session IDs, including blank sessions, are reused without creating a session
or changing its title. A truly unbound draft starts generation first, then asynchronously creates a

necessary session and binds that same job, without stealing navigation.
- Host jobs have a ten-minu
te in-memory retention period. Host restart removes stale running state cleanly.
## Install
Published release:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
For a local candidate, run `npm pack`, then `dsh plugin --profile <name> add ./dsh-prompt-seed-0.21.

1.tgz`.
Keep the previous package for recovery and restart DSH while idle after Host changes. Use th

e compatible CLI bundled with Desktop. Do not edit the installed copy.
Remove with `dsh plugin --pro
file <name> remove dsh-prompt-seed`.
## Config
[代码示例省略，未执行]
User templates in `$DSH_HOME/prompt-seed/prompts/` remain intact: `optimize.md` takes precedence, th

en legacy `seed.md`.
Existing `clarify`, `precise` and `chat` files are preserved but are not select

ed by the single rewrite contract.
Local sample logs contain input/output previews and are never aut
omatically uploaded; `samples:false` disables them.
## HTTP compatibility
`POST /api/prompt-seed/optimize` remains loopback-only and requires `application/json`.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Actions: `optimize / predict / status / bind / cancel / consume`. Queries and binding default to opt
imize when `kind` is omitted. New clients pass `"optimize"` or `"predict"`. Cancellation/consumption
retain legacy jobId-only calls; an explicit kind validates ownership.
Both generators accept `stream:true` and return NDJSON `meta / delta / final` events with jobId and

kind.
Nonstream optimize retains its final JSON. Nonstream predict retains `{ok:true,text}` or `{ok:

false,code,error}` without requiring new fields.
Status adds `protocolVersion:2`, `ui.composerButton
`, context availability and the last persisted user-message identifier, not chat content. `?debug=1`

adds diagnostics to nonstream optimize.
Failures, empty/truncated results and lost explicit full pa
ths/files/URLs/identifiers never overwrite the draft.
## Development and acceptance
Node ≥22.19; zero runtime dependencies, no install step needed.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
| Validation | Count |
| Real-socket checks | ✅ 13 checks, run by `npm test` |
`src/` is authoritative; rebuild `lib/` after editing. Behavioral tests drive the shipped toolbar/co
ntroller with controllable drafts, sessions and model streams rather than checking function names.
`bench/corpus.json` contains 30 rewrite cases; `bench/predict-corpus.json` contains 10 contextual pr

ediction cases.
